U_0x0061E7:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight the demons called the "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.
Its slender Black Serpent Sword and Burinkou shield suit close-to-mid range. The sword, a chain of Jatorin segments, flexes, stretches, and even becomes BuJakuOh's Black Serpent Mortar - a feat of the Sofu, the talismans forming the Four Gods, which allow their miraculous transformations and combinations.
JakuBuOh is fierce and proud - female, in human terms. Scarred in past wars, its form has changed often; Xia Nan and Tai Bei restored it near its true shape, adding Sofu parts based on a special humanoid weapon.
U_0x00674D:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight the demons called the "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.
The huge shell on its back and its Shinju Shield barrier give it the Four Gods' highest defense, and the self-repair of its Sofu - the talismans forming a <Chokijin>'s body - far outstrips the others. It also bears Sofu parts based on a special humanoid weapon, including modern missile launchers. Its main arm, the Black Serpent Mortar formed from JakuBuOh's sword, suits it to bombardment; it can further become the Genten Shoutenhou for ultra-long-range fire. In return its mobility is low and melee is a weak point. BuJakuOh is calm, quiet, and patient.
U_0x006C10: TA Four Gods <Chokijin> modeled on Suzaku. Excels at fast air combat, outflying RyuOhKi.
U_0x006CB2: A Four Gods <Chokijin> modeled on Genbu. Defense is high but mobility low; its true role is shielding other units, and it fights poorly in this form.
